description:
## Summary
Port the `/logout` command, which is missing from octo_pi's autocomplete and command dispatcher.

## Observed Upstream Behavior
`/logout` opens an `OAuthSelectorComponent` overlay listing all configured auth providers so the user can select one to deauthorize.

UI elements visible in the overlay:
```
─────────────────────────────────────
  Select provider to logout:

  [search input]

  > Anthropic (Claude)  ✓ configured    ← selected (accent, → prefix)
    OpenAI              • unconfigured
    OpenRouter          ✓ env: OPENROUTER_API_KEY

─────────────────────────────────────
```

Status indicators per provider:
- `success(" ✓ configured")` — credential stored and matches expected type
- `muted(" • ") + warning(label)` — credential stored but wrong type (e.g., subscription when API key expected)
- `muted(" • unconfigured")` — no credential
- `success(" ✓ env: ${label}")` — sourced from environment variable
- `success(" ✓ runtime API key")`
- `success(" ✓ custom API key")`
- `success(" ✓ key in models.json")`
- `success(" ✓ command in models.json")`

Keyboard actions:
- **↑/↓**: move selection
- **Enter**: logout the selected provider (remove stored credential), dismiss overlay
- **Type**: fuzzy-filter provider list; search input is focused
- **Escape**: cancel without logging out

Header uses `bold+accent` styling.

## Source References
- Component: `tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/components/oauth-selector.ts`
- Handler: `tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/interactive-mode.ts` ~line 4475 `showOAuthSelector("logout")`
- Command registration: `tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/slash-commands.ts` — entry `"logout"`

## What to Implement in Elixir
1. Add `"logout"` to `builtin_commands/0` in `autocomplete.ex`
2. Add `/logout` dispatch clause
3. Port `OAuthSelectorComponent` in logout mode: bold+accent title, search input, provider list with per-provider status indicators using correct color tokens
4. On Enter: remove stored credential for selected provider, dismiss overlay
5. Escape cancels
title: Port /logout command
